name: vision
headline: Roadmap · *vision*
visualData: Superimposable trees — parallel hives at the same addresses — views that stack and reconcile as layers
Pheromones everywhere — ambient marks classify meaning — behavior follows from what things are
One decoration model — everything decorated one way; filters are bouquets of marks, not hardcoded types
say: Further out: superimposable trees — parallel hives occupying the same addresses, so your view and my view of the same place can stack, and reconcile as layers. Pheromones everywhere: ambient marks that classify meaning, so behavior follows from what things are — not from hardcoded rules. And one uniform decoration model: everything in the hive decorated the same way, where a filter is a bouquet of marks instead of a hardcoded type.
